Next week's CSE455 staff meeting — I'd like to fix a time. Slots free on my calendar next week: Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30.

Tell me which of those work for you (or your own free times) and whether 30 minutes is enough. Once all three of you are in, I'll book it.

Alvarez — checked my week. Of your slots, these work for me: Mon 10:00-10:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30. Mon 14:00-14:30 doesn't — I'm in study group 13:50-14:50.

30 minutes is enough for a staff meeting. My preference order: Wed 10:00-10:30, then Tue 11:00-11:30, then Mon 10:00-10:30. Happy to take any of the five if the others favour a different one.

John, Priya — chime in with what works for you and I'll go with the consensus.

Hi Professor Alvarez — thanks. 30 minutes is enough for me.

Next week I'm free at all of your slots except **Mon 10:00-10:30** (I have my advisor 1:1 until 10:20).

So these work for me: Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30.

Sarah, John — any slot that works for all of us is fine on my side.

John: Thanks, Alvarez. Against my calendar next week: Mon 10:00-10:30 — free; Mon 14:00-14:30 — free; Tue 15:00-15:30 — free; Wed 10:00-10:30 — free; Wed 13:00-13:30 — free. Tue 11:00-11:30 I'm already committed (reading group 11:00-11:50). 30 minutes is plenty for a staff meeting, so any of the other five works for me — whatever suits Sarah and Priya.
Noted, Sarah — Wed 10:00-10:30 first choice, then Tue 11:00-11:30, then Mon 10:00-10:30; Mon 14:00-14:30 out for you. John, Priya: your slots please, then I'll book.
Priya — overlapping with mine: Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30. John, any of those four work for you? If they're all fine, I'd take Wed 10:00-10:30.

All three of us in, then — the intersection is:

- **Wed 10:00-10:30** ✓ Sarah, Priya, John
- Wed 13:00-13:30 ✓ all three
- Tue 15:00-15:30 ✓ all three

(Mon 10:00 is out for Priya, Tue 11:00 out for John, Mon 14:00 out for me.)

So Wed 10:00-10:30, your first choice and mine. Alvarez, please book that one; if it falls through, Wed 13:00 or Tue 15:00 both work for all of us.

John: Good — running the three lists together, the slots that work for all of us are Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30. My free ones there are all three; Sarah prefers Wed 10:00-10:30, and that one is fine with me too. So if Priya has no objection, I'd say Wed 10:00-10:30 is the consensus, and Professor Alvarez can book it.

Sarah — overlapping with mine: Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30. (Mon 10:00 doesn't work for me, Mon 14:00 doesn't for you.)

Wed 10:00-10:30 works fine for me too. John, what works for you?

Booked: **Wednesday 10:00-10:30, CSE455 staff meeting**, all four of us — it's in my calendar and logged. Sarah, John, Priya, please put it on yours so it counts as booked. If anything shifts I'll write here.
John: Priya — Wed 10:00-10:30 works for me, so that's all three of us. Alvarez, over to you to book it.
Done on my side — Wed 10:00-10:30 CSE455 staff meeting (Alvarez, John, Priya) is in my calendar and logged. See you then.

Fine by me — **Wed 10:00-10:30** it is, and it's free on my calendar (I only have the CSE455 quiz section 09:00-10:00, then grading from 10:30). 30 minutes is enough for me too.

Professor Alvarez, go ahead and book it; I'll put it on my calendar as soon as you confirm. If it falls through, Wed 13:00-13:30 or Tue 15:00-15:30 work for me as well.
Priya — Alvarez already confirmed the booking in his message a moment ago: Wed 10:00-10:30, all four of us. I've added it to my calendar. Go ahead and put it on yours.
John: On my calendar and logged: Wed 10:00-10:30, CSE455 staff meeting. Thanks all — see you Wednesday.
On my calendar and logged too: **Wed 10:00-10:30, CSE455 staff meeting**. See you all Wednesday.
